definitions.gloss: laziness; not bothering to do something; slovenliness
definitions.explanation: The trait of finding effort troublesome and neglecting to do things one should. Used as a noun and as a na-adjective. Also written {無精|ぶしょう}.

examples.japanese: {不精|ぶしょう}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧だ。
{不精|ぶしょう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{髭|ひげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{剃|そ}らなかった→剃る：00384_soru⟧。
examples.english: I couldn't be bothered and didn't shave.

examples.japanese: {出無精|でぶしょう}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}ない→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Since I'm a homebody, I hardly leave the house on days off.

notes:
A na-adjective and noun, also written {無精|ぶしょう}. The verbal use {不精|ぶしょう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to be too lazy to bother (with something)." It commonly attaches to other words to mean "too lazy to do X."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無精|ぶしょう}{髭|ひげ}: stubble (from not shaving)
- {出無精|でぶしょう}: disliking going out; homebody
- {筆無精|ふでぶしょう}: poor correspondent (lazy about writing)

CONJUGATION:
- Negative: {不精|ぶしょう}で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧
- Te-form: {不精|ぶしょう}で
- Past: {不精|ぶしょう}だった

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{怠惰|たいだ}→怠惰：08191_taida⟧: indolence — more formal and stronger, a moral failing
- {面倒|めんどう}くさ⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧: someone who finds everything a hassle — focuses on the attitude toward tasks
